title: F-35C flight operations
description: PACIFIC OCEAN (Nov. 16, 2021) An F-35C Lightning II, assigned to the "Black Knights" of Marine Fighter Attack Squadron (VMFA) 314, launches and lands on the flight deck of USS Abraham Lincoln (CVN 72). Abraham Lincoln is underway conducting routine operations in the U.S. 3rd Fleet. (U.S. Navy video by Mass Communication Specialist 3rd Class Michael Singley/Released)
